measurement: query_roundtrip_ms starts before GET /api/system and includes the following GET /api/objects; it is their combined wall time, not isolated object-list latency.
memory_scope: cgroup memory includes cache and all prior retained data. Maxima are sampled values for this test window, not continuous peaks or guaranteed capacity.
limitations: Monitoring starts about 7.2 seconds after generation starts; the first seconds have no samples.
Whole monitor window includes about 11.6 seconds after the 30-second run finishes.
No percentile or long-duration performance claim is made.
